notes_dir.label: Notes folder
notes_dir.description: Folder that stores the note files.

search_limit.label: Search result limit
search_limit.description: Maximum number of app search results (3-20).

recent_count.label: Recent files shown
recent_count.description: How many recent files the card lists (3-15).

motion.label: Card motion
motion.description: Light expands content immediately with brief arrow feedback, avoiding repeated scroll resizing. Soft keeps a short reveal. Off only disables card motion, not the panel animation.
